_meta.what: Rents actually paid or offered on a fixed lease in Niagara Falls commercial space, as stated in properties and businesses listed for sale (rent rolls and lease terms). Rent per sq ft a year = monthly rent x 12 / stated floor area.
_meta.collected: 2026-11-19 from caprate.ca listing pages (MLS feed; the site's robots.txt allows AI readers). Each row names its MLS number; the page is https://caprate.ca/listings/<address-slug>-<mls>/.
_meta.terms: basis says whether the rent includes taxes and running costs (gross) or not (net), as the listing states; 'unstated' when it does not say. HST is never included. Gross rents run roughly $8-10 a sq ft above net in this market (TMI quoted at $8 on Thorold Stone Road and $10 on Centre Street, 2025-2026).
_meta.kind: in_place = a tenant pays it now; offered = the lease a buyer of the business takes on; seller_leaseback = the seller's offer to stay as tenant (set by the seller, may be high); contracted = a future step in a signed lease.
_meta.dating: Rents are as of the listing (2026) unless a lease date is given. These are signed-lease rents, not asking rents, so they lag the market: a lease signed years ago is still in place.

history.place: Niagara Square, 7555 Montrose Rd (enclosed mall, anchors included)
history.what: RioCan bought a 30% interest for $14.1 million at a cap rate of 8.4% (RioCan Q3 2010 results). Implied value of the whole centre $47.0 million; net operating income 8.4% of that = $3.95 million a year over 382,300 sq ft = about $10.3 a sq ft a year (net of running costs, averaged over anchors, small shops and any empty space).
history.note: A whole-mall average, not a shop rent: anchors pay far less a sq ft than small shops. Later redeveloped into an open-air centre of 265,611 sq ft with Costco next door.
